name: Code Slots
description: One-time code input made of animated digit slots. Digits spring in, a caret glides between slots, errors drain the digits out, and success washes the row with an accent color and a check icon.
contents: Row of digit slots with a hidden numeric input on top
Animated caret that glides between slots
Screen reader live region with digit count
behavior: Digits scale in with a spring and cascade when pasted
Backspace, Delete, arrow keys, Home and End move or clear slots; click selects the first empty slot at most
status error drains filled digits in reverse order, tints slots red, then clears the code
status success reveals an accent wash from the center, sinks digits and pops in a check icon
Works controlled (value) or uncontrolled (defaultValue), fires onChange and onComplete when all slots fill
Respects reduced motion by jumping without animation
editableByProps: Code length, initial or controlled value, masking, caret, disabled and autofocus
Idle, error or success state via status
Colors for accent, caret, slot, digit and error
Spring bounce, settle time, digit rise distance and paste cascade delay
Accessible label and extra class name

needsCodeEdit.where: digitsOf helper, the /^[0-9]$/ test in onKeyDown, and the inputMode and pattern attributes on the input
HugeiconsIcon with Tick02Icon inside the wash motion.span

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the success and error timings
needsCodeEdit.where: WASH_IN, WASH_OUT, SINK_DELAY, SINK_STEP, CHECK_DELAY, CHECK_RISE and SINK_FADE constants
The aria-live span with id ending in -count

fixed: Digits only, other characters are ignored
Requires motion and @hugeicons/react with @hugeicons/core-free-icons, and Tailwind CSS 4 classes
Injects a style tag with the code-slots-blink keyframes
Input is disabled for typing while status is success or while error drain runs
Error status clears the code after the drain animation
Mask character is a fixed bullet
Slot height is fixed at 1.18 times slot size and font size at half of slot size
